name: ufc-marx
description: UFC MarX Risk Engine — dual-mode (static zero-backend OR Supabase-backed persistent with save/share/bet-tracking).

scripts.install:all: npm install ; cd backend ; npm install
scripts.lint: node --check js/app.js ; node --check js/fightnomics.js ; node --check js/data.js ; cd backend ; npm run check:all
scripts.sync:bundle: Copy-Item -Force data/fighter_stats_bundle.js backend/src/services/fighter_stats_bundle.js ; Copy-Item -Force js/fightnomics.js backend/src/services/fightnomics.js ; Write-Host 'Synced fightnomics.js + fighter_stats_bundle.js → backend/'
scripts.verify:drift: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const a=fs.readFileSync('js/fightnomics.js','utf8'); const b=fs.readFileSync('backend/src/services/fightnomics.js','utf8'); const c=fs.readFileSync('data/fighter_stats_bundle.js','utf8'); const d=fs.readFileSync('backend/src/services/fighter_stats_bundle.js','utf8'); console.log('fightnomics drift:', a===b ? 'OK' : 'DRIFT'); console.log('bundle drift:     ', c===d ? 'OK' : 'DRIFT'); process.exit((a===b && c===d)?0:1);"
